Merge-sort variant: count pairs (i, j) with i<j and a[i]>a[j]. O(n log n).

```python
def count_inversions(nums):
    def merge_count(arr):
        if len(arr) <= 1:
            return arr, 0
        mid = len(arr) // 2
        left, lc = merge_count(arr[:mid])
        right, rc = merge_count(arr[mid:])
        merged, cross = [], 0
        i = j = 0
        while i < len(left) and j < len(right):
            if left[i] <= right[j]:
                merged.append(left[i])
                i += 1
            else:
                merged.append(right[j])
                cross += len(left) - i
                j += 1
        merged.extend(left[i:])
        merged.extend(right[j:])
        return merged, lc + rc + cross
    _, count = merge_count(nums)
    return count
```
